decision: Use only the validated WebGL1 subresult of the unchanged full observation. T=verified stable numeric/string conflict; F=all requested WebGL1 comparisons match; U=missing, invalid, failed or unstable WebGL1/envelope. F is not a device-safety or WebGL2 assertion.
quality_guards: Original envelope versions, scope and ordered context set
WebGL1 context and extension observed and available
WebGL1 initialization error queue empty and context not lost
Vendor/renderer arguments, types, statuses and errors valid; stable numeric endpoints
webgl2_policy: Always retain raw observation and full v1 outcome. Neither WebGL2 counterexamples nor UNKNOWN supply this candidate state.
scope_counterexample: An attack affecting only WebGL2 can be missed by this candidate. That is outside the predicate; do not claim coverage of all WebGL manipulation.
selection_basis: LOCALIZATION.json: initialization error is visible before observer extension/parameter reads, confined to API36 host WebGL2 in the measured profiles; no error observed in WebGL1.
root_cause_limit: Exact WebView/ANGLE/driver cause not identified. No error suppression or native driver fix claimed.
next_validation: New App installs/processes/sessions on all four preselected environments, 2 normal-attack-restoration triplets each, 24 payloads; frozen before this validation begins.
acceptance: All 24 positions captured and session-bound; no replacement
All 8 triplets have raw target effect, raw/sidecar restoration, other 10 graphics fields unchanged and canonical WebGL1 linkage
Candidate states F,T,F in all 8 triplets and no candidate U
Report unchanged full v1 outcomes separately; they are allowed to retain the known UNKNOWN
not_authorized_by_pass: Selector registration or model fit performed automatically
Claiming model improvement, physical-device FPR or independent confirmation
inference_scope: One Mac, emulator configs, WebView91/134 and one existing plugin configuration. New captures validate a development contract, not unseen attack tools or normal apps.
